description: Comprehensive guide for merchant order management

questions.question: How do I accept a new order?
questions.answer:
To accept an order:
1. You'll receive a push notification immediately
2. Open the WhizzMerchants app
3. Tap on the order in the Orders tab
4. Review order details carefully
5. Tap the green 'Accept Order' button
6. Preparation timer starts automatically

⏰ Important: You have 2 minutes to accept before the order is auto-rejected.

questions.question: Why am I not receiving orders?
questions.answer:
Check these common issues:

1. ✅ Store Status: Tap profile → Ensure 'Open' status
2. 🔔 Notifications: Settings → Enable push notifications
3. 📍 Location: Enable GPS/location services
4. 🌐 Internet: Check WiFi or mobile data
5. ⏰ Business Hours: Verify working hours are correct
6. 📱 App Version: Update to latest version in app store
7. 👤 Account Status: Ensure account is verified and active

If all above are correct and still no orders after 30 minutes, contact support immediately.

questions.question: How do I cancel or refund an order?
questions.answer:
⚠️ Order Cancellation Process:

**Before Preparation Started:**
- Tap order → 'Cancel Order' button
- Select cancellation reason
- Confirm cancellation
- Customer receives full automatic refund

**After Preparation Started:**
- First, contact customer via in-app chat
- Explain the situation
- Get customer agreement if possible
- Tap 'Request Support' in order details
- Support team will process refund

💰 Note: Frequent cancellations (>10% of orders) may affect your merchant rating and could lead to account suspension.

questions.question: What happens if I miss an order notification?
questions.answer:
If you don't accept an order within 2 minutes:

❌ **Immediate Effects:**
- Order is automatically rejected
- Customer is notified and can choose another merchant
- You receive a 'missed order' mark

📊 **Impact on Your Business:**
- 3+ missed orders in 24 hours: Warning notification
- 5+ missed orders in a week: Account review
- Consistent pattern: Temporary suspension possible

✅ **Prevention Tips:**
- Keep app open during business hours
- Enable loud notifications
- Set realistic operating hours
- Close store if unable to fulfill orders

questions.question: How do I mark an order as ready for pickup?
questions.answer:
When order is prepared:

1. Open the active order
2. Tap 'Order Ready' button
3. Driver is notified immediately
4. Order moves to 'Ready for Pickup' status

⏱️ **Timing Guidelines:**
- Mark ready only when fully prepared
- Include all items and packaging
- Verify order completeness
- Driver typically arrives within 5-10 minutes

📦 **Checklist:**
✅ All items prepared
✅ Correct quantities
✅ Special instructions followed
✅ Properly packaged
✅ Utensils/napkins included

questions.question: What should I do if the driver hasn't arrived?
questions.answer:
If driver is delayed:

**First 10 minutes:**
- Wait patiently, drivers may be finishing previous delivery
- Keep order ready and accessible

**After 10 minutes:**
- Tap order → View driver location
- Check if driver is approaching

**After 20 minutes:**
- Tap 'Contact Driver' in order details
- Call or message driver

**After 30 minutes:**
- Tap 'Request Support' in order
- Support will reassign driver or resolve issue

⚠️ Important: Don't give order to anyone without verifying their driver ID and order code.

questions.question: How do I handle special instructions or dietary requirements?
questions.answer:
Handling special requests:

✅ **Always Check:**
- Review 'Special Instructions' section in order
- Look for allergy warnings (marked with ⚠️)
- Check for dietary preferences (vegan, halal, etc.)

🚫 **Cannot Accommodate:**
- Contact customer immediately via in-app chat
- Explain what you can/cannot do
- Offer alternatives if possible
- Allow customer to cancel if needed

✅ **Successfully Handled:**
- Follow instructions precisely
- Use separate preparation areas for allergies
- Mark items clearly
- Add confirmation note in chat

⚠️ **Food Allergies:** Take these VERY seriously. If unsure, recommend customer cancels for safety.

questions.question: What is the preparation time and can I change it?
questions.answer:
**Preparation Time Overview:**

⏱️ **Standard Times:**
- Your default prep time is set in Business Settings
- Typical range: 15-45 minutes depending on cuisine
- Shown to customers before they order

🔄 **Changing Prep Time:**
- Go to Settings → Business Info → Preparation Time
- Adjust based on your actual speed
- Changes apply to new orders immediately

⚡ **Best Practices:**
- Set realistic times (avoid rushing)
- Add 5-10 min buffer for busy periods
- Account for complex menu items
- Update during peak hours if needed

📊 **Impact:**
- Longer prep time: Fewer orders but more manageable
- Shorter prep time: More orders but must keep pace
- Consistently late: Negative ratings

questions.question: How do I handle order complaints or issues after delivery?
questions.answer:
**Post-Delivery Issues:**

📱 **If Customer Contacts You Directly:**
1. Listen to their concern
2. Apologize for the inconvenience
3. Offer a solution (refund/remake)
4. Document the issue

🔄 **Resolution Options:**
- Full refund: Serious quality issues
- Partial refund: Minor missing items
- Offer voucher: Future order discount
- Remake order: If customer nearby

📊 **Reporting:**
- Go to Order History
- Find the order
- Tap 'Report Issue'
- Select issue type
- Add description
- Submit for review

⚠️ **Important:** Be proactive - address quality issues before customer complains. Maintain high standards to avoid refunds and negative ratings.

questions.question: Can I pause or temporarily stop receiving orders?
questions.answer:
**Pausing Orders:**

✅ **Quick Pause:**
- Tap your profile icon
- Toggle 'Store Open/Closed' switch
- Orders stop immediately
- Customers see 'Currently Closed'

⏰ **Scheduled Breaks:**
- Go to Settings → Business Hours
- Set break times (e.g., 3-4 PM)
- Applies automatically daily

🔔 **Auto-Resume:**
- App can auto-open at scheduled times
- Enable in Settings → Operating Hours

💡 **Use Cases:**
- Lunch break
- Restocking ingredients
- Handling rush
- Staff shortage
- Kitchen maintenance

⚠️ **Note:** Frequent on/off toggling may affect your visibility in customer search results. Use scheduled hours for predictable breaks.
